2026-10-27.homeNewsDetails: Vladar will start vs. Columbus on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: After allowing 15 goals on 105 shots (.857 SV%) in his first three games (0-3-0), Vladar has rebounded in recent games and hopes to continue the upward trend on Tuesday against the Columbus Blue Jackets. The 29-year-old Czech goalie has allowed two or fewer goals in three straight games (2-0-1), saving 81 of 85 combined shots (.953 SV%). The Flyers enter Tuesday's game as slight +109 home underdogs against a Blue Jackets team coming off a 2-1 win over the Vegas Golden Knights.
2026-10-27.awayNewsDetails: Talbot will start in Philadelphia on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Jet Greaves was expected to carry a heavy workload this season, but some rough outings have left Talbot between the pipes in three of four games for the Blue Jackets. The 39-year-old Talbot was excellent in his most recent outing, saving 26 of 27 shots (.963 SV%) in a 2-1 overtime win over the Vegas Golden Knights. He has a 2.82 GAA and .891 SV% in five appearances this season (2-2-0). The Blue Jackets enter Tuesday's game as -120 road favourites against a Philadelphia Flyers team whose three-game winning streak was snapped on Saturday in a 5-4 loss to the Anaheim Ducks.

2026-10-27.homeNewsDetails: Binnington will start vs. Montreal on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: The Blues have deviated from veteran Jordan Binnington this season, leaning heavily on Joel Hofer for eight of 11 games. That said, Binnington will return to the crease on Tuesday, looking for his second win of the season. The 33-year-old Canadian goalie has an ugly 4.68 GAA and .831 SV% in three games (1-2-0). He allowed five goals on 24 shots (.792 SV%) in his most recent outing, a 5-2 loss to the Nashville Predators. The Blues enter Tuesday's action as -114 home favourites against a Montreal Canadiens team with points in four straight games (3-0-1).
2026-10-27.awayNewsDetails: Fowler will start in St. Louis on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Jakub Dobes had a breakout 2025-26 season, leading the Canadiens to an impressive playoff run, but his sluggish start to 2026-27 opened a door for Jacob Fowler. The 21-year-old Fowler was outstanding in his most recent game, saving 33 of 34 shots (.971 SV%) in a 2-1 win over the Winnipeg Jets. He has a stellar 1.79 GAA and .924 SV% in six games this season (5-1-0). The Canadiens enter Tuesday's contest as slight +101 road underdogs against a St. Louis Blues team coming off a 4-0 shutout loss to the Carolina Hurricanes.

2026-10-27.homeNewsDetails: Knight will start vs. Los Angeles.
2026-10-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Knight played well in his previous game, stopping 31 of 34 shots (.912 SV%), but didn't get enough goal support in a 3-2 loss to his former team, the Florida Panthers. The 25-year-old Knight has allowed three or more goals in six straight games (2-4-0), posting a 3.54 GAA and .891 SV%. The Blackhawks enter Tuesday's game as slight +101 home underdogs against a low-scoring Los Angeles Kings team that exploded for a season-high six-goal output in yesterday's 6-3 win over the New York Rangers.
2026-10-27.awayNewsDetails: Forsberg led the Kings onto the ice for warmups.
2026-10-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: After a 6-3 win over the New York Rangers last night, the Kings will turn to Forsberg tonight as the back-to-back winds down. Forsberg was solid in his most recent game, stopping 23 of 25 shots (.920 SV%), but fell short in a 3-1 loss to the New Jersey Devils. The 33-year-old Swedish goalie has a 2.48 GAA and .894 SV% in four appearances this season (0-2-1). The Kings enter Tuesday's game as -112 road favourites against a Chicago Blackhawks team that has scored two or fewer goals in three straight games (0-3-0).

2026-10-27.homeNewsDetails: DeSmith will start vs. New Jersey on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: The Stars are riding a league-best five-game winning streak, starting with a 25-save performance (.926 SV%) by Casey DeSmith in a 3-2 win over the Colorado Avalanche on October 14th. The 35-year-old DeSmith has not played since, but he returns to the crease Tuesday, looking to build on a 1.94 GAA and .925 SV% over two games (1-1-0). The Stars enter Tuesday's contest as -115 home favourites against a New Jersey Devils team that has outscored opponents 11-5 over a three-game winning streak.
2026-10-27.awayNewsDetails: Hellebuyck will make his Devils' debut and start in Dallas on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Hellebuyck joined the Devils for practice on Monday and will make his debut Tuesday against the Dallas Stars. The 33-year-old Hellebuyck, a three-time Vezina Trophy winner, has yet to play this season, refusing to report to Winnipeg's training camp amid his trade request, and comes off a 2025-26 season with a 2.86 GAA and .895 SV% in 57 games (23-23-11). The Devils enter Tuesday's contest as -103 road underdogs against a Dallas Stars team on a five-game winning streak. The Devils may ease Hellebuyck into action early, but expect him to carry a heavy workload as the season progresses and the Devils hope to return to the postseason.

2026-10-27.homeNewsDetails: Kochetkov led the Hurricanes onto the ice for warmups.
2026-10-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Hurricanes Head Coach Rod Brind'Amour started Brandon Bussi in the first two games of the season, but has leaned more heavily on Kochetkov in recent games. The 27-year-old goalie returns to the crease on Tuesday for his eighth start in Carolina's last 11 games and, deservedly, after posting a tremendous undefeated 7-0-0 record with a 1.70 GAA and .916 SV%. He recorded his first shutout of the season in his most recent outing, saving 24 shots in a 4-0 win over the St. Louis Blues. The Hurricanes enter Tuesday's contest as -185 home favourites against a 9-2-1 Boston Bruins team.
2026-10-27.awayNewsDetails: Swayman will start in Carolina on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: The Bruins lead the Atlantic Division with a 9-2-1 record, largely thanks to the stellar play of Jeremy Swayman. The 27-year-old Swayman is coming off one of his weakest performances of the season, allowing four goals on 27 shots (.852 SV%), but he still salvaged a 6-4 win over the San Jose Sharks. In nine games this season (7-1-1), Swayman has a solid 2.20 GAA and .920 SV%. The Bruins enter Tuesday's contest against the Metropolitan Division-leading Carolina Hurricanes, who are 8-1-1 in their last 10 games.

2026-10-27.homeNewsDetails: Saros led the Predators onto the ice for warmups.
2026-10-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Saros has had consecutive disappointing seasons, finishing with sub- .900 SV% for the first two times in his career, but is off to an encouraging start in 2026-27. Despite a modest 3-2-3 record, Saros has been serviceable with a 2.82 GAA and .908 SV% in eight games. The Predators enter Tuesday's contest as -116 home favourites against a New York Islanders team coming off a disappointing 6-3 loss to the Dallas Stars.
2026-10-27.awayNewsDetails: Varlamov will start in Nashville on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: After being sidelined from November 2024 until the start of this season, the Islanders have used Varlamov sparingly, but he will return to the crease for his fourth start on Tuesday. The 38-year-old Varlamov was serviceable in his most recent game, saving 24 of 27 shots (.889 SV%), but came up short in a 3-2 overtime loss to the Los Angeles Kings. He is still searching for his first win this season, posting a 2.25 GAA and .899 SV% in three games (0-1-2). The Islanders enter Tuesday's game as slight +106 road underdogs against a Nashville Predators team coming off an impressive 6-2 win over the Colorado Avalanche.

2026-10-27.homeNewsDetails: Stevenson will start vs. Florida on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: The Jets finally traded Connor Hellebuyck last week after his highly publicized trade request and subsequent team suspension, with goalie Nico Daws returning from New Jersey as one of the pieces. That said, at least for now, the Jets will stick with their original goalie tandem of Stuart Skinner and Clay Stevenson, turning to Stevenson on Tuesday against the Florida Panthers. The 27-year-old Stevenson has been serviceable, albeit unspectacular this season, posting a 3.08 GAA and .893 SV% in three games (1-2-0). A strong performance from Stevenson on Tuesday will go a long way toward helping him secure playing time going forward. The Jets enter the action as +113 home underdogs.
2026-10-27.awayNewsDetails: Schmid will start in Winnipeg on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: With Jacob Markstrom (upper body) on Injured Reserve, Florida will turn to Schmid for the third time in their past four games. Schmid was solid in his most recent outing, saving 19 of 21 shots (.905 SV%) in a 3-2 win over the Chicago Blackhawks. The 26-year-old Swiss goalie has a 3.34 GAA and .872 SV% in six games (3-2-1). The Panthers enter Tuesday's contest as -126 road underdogs against a Winnipeg Jets team on a five-game losing streak (0-3-2).

2026-10-27.homeNewsDetails: Vejmelka will start vs. Minnesota on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Vejmelka hasn't been overly impressive this season, but sports a solid 6-3-0 record and will continue to be leaned on by the Utah Mammoth. The 30-year-old Czech goalie saved 29 of 32 shots (.906 SV%) in his most recent game, a 5-4 overtime win over the Tampa Bay Lightning. He has a 3.13 GAA and .313 SV% in 10 appearances. Utah enters Tuesday's contest as -113 home favourites against a Minnesota Wild team that has outscored opponents 9-3 in their last two games (2-0-0).
2026-10-27.awayNewsDetails: Wallstedt will start in Utah on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Wallstedt has been busy with Filip Gustavsson (hip) sidelined and will return to the crease for the 12th time in Minnesota's first 14 games. The 23-year-old Swedish goalie has given Head Coach John Hynes no reason to deviate, posting a solid 2.08 GAA and .918 SV% in 11 games (7-2-2). He saved 23 of 24 shots (.958 SV%) in his most recent outing, a 5-1 win over the Seattle Kraken. Minnesota enters Tuesday's game as slight +104 road underdogs against a Utah Mammoth team that has scored five goals in each of its last three games (3-0-0).

2026-10-27.homeNewsDetails: Hill will start vs. Ottawa on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Hill won his first four games of the season but is coming off a forgettable fifth, allowing six goals on 31 shots (.806 SV%) in a 6-2 loss to the St. Louis Blues. The 30-year-old Hill has a 2.95 GAA and .882 SV% in five games (4-1-0). The Golden Knights enter Tuesday's outing as -155 home favourites against an Ottawa Senators team coming off a 7-4 win over the New York Rangers.
2026-10-27.awayNewsDetails: Johansson will start in Vegas on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: With Linus Ullmark (lower body) expected to miss another week, the Senators will continue to roll with Samuel Ersson and Jonas Johansson, turning to Johansson on Tuesday against the Vegas Golden Knights. The 31-year-old was far from stellar in his only outing this season, allowing four goals on 28 shots (.857 SV%) in a 7-4 loss to the New York Rangers. The Senators enter Tuesday's game as +139 road underdogs against a Vegas Golden Knights team that has scored only three goals in its past two games (0-1-1).

2026-10-27.homeNewsDetails: Dostal will start vs. Vancouver on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Dostal has played eight of 11 games for the Ducks this season and will return to the crease on Tuesday. The 26-year-old Czech goalie was serviceable in his most recent outing, saving 28 of 32 shots (.875 SV%) in a 5-4 win over the Philadelphia Flyers. He has a 3.27 GAA and .880 SV% in eight games (4-4-0). The Ducks enter Tuesday's contest as sizeable -208 home favourites against a league-worst 2-10-1 Vancouver Canucks team that has scored two or fewer goals in nine of its last 10 games (0-9-1).
2026-10-27.awayNewsDetails: Meriläinen led the Canucks onto the ice for warmups.

2026-10-27.homeNewsDetails: Askarov will start vs. Buffalo on Tuesday.
2026-10-27.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Askarov started the season with a dreadful 4.00 GAA and .848 SV% in his first five games (2-3-0), but has turned things around in recent outings. In his past two games (1-1-0), the the 24-year-old Russian goalie has stopped 70 of 74 shots (.946 SV%) and hopes to carry that momentum into Tuesday's game against the Buffalo Sabres. The Sharks enter Tuesday's game as +129 road underdogs against a Sabres team on a three-game losing skid (0-1-2).
2026-10-27.awayNewsDetails: Ellis is in the starter's crease at Buffalo's morning skate.
2026-10-27.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Still without Alex Lyon (upper body), the Sabres have mostly relied on Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen, but they will turn to Ellis on Tuesday. The 26-year-old Ellis has not played since October 12th, when he allowed two goals on nine shots (.778 SV%) in a relief performance in a 5-3 win over the Florida Panthers. Ellis has a 3.19 GAA and .864 SV% in three appearances (1-1-0). The Sabres enter Tuesday's contest as -143 road favourites against a San Jose Sharks team that has scored 16 goals in their past three games (2-1-0).
